title: Hyogo Prefectural Museum of History — Japanese current visitor conditions

facts.fact: The usual weekly closure is Monday; if Monday is a holiday, the museum opens then and closes on the next weekday.
facts.excerpt: 月曜日が祝日・休日の場合は開館。翌平日が休館

facts.fact: First-floor exhibition access is free; second-floor special and planned exhibitions can change the applicable charge.
facts.excerpt:
1階 無料ゾーン
1階は無料ゾーンです。
facts.location: 観覧料金, raw extracted TXT under heading1階無料ゾーン; separate heading2階常設有料ゾーン states special/planned exhibition charges may change

facts.fact: Second-floor paid-zone entry uses a ticket QR code, including a ticket issued for high-school-age or younger visitors whose admission is free.
facts.excerpt: 2階有料ゾーンは、チケットのQRコードを使用した入場となります。
facts.location: 2階 常設有料ゾーン, visitor ticket paragraph; following sentence specifies ticket issuance for high-school-age or younger visitors
